attrs.body:
for a0 in 0..2:
    for a1 in 0..64:
        in0 = load x[a0, a1]
        acc0 <- maximum(acc0, in0) over a1
    for a1 in 0..64:
        in1 = load x[a0, a1]
        v0 = subtract(in1, acc0)
        v1 = exp(v0)
        acc1 <- add(acc1, v1) over a1
    for a3 in 0..64:
        in2 = load x[a0, a3]
        v2 = subtract(in2, acc0)
        v3 = exp(v2)
        v4 = divide(v3, acc1)
        softmax[a0, a3] = v4
